## Video-Catcher 0.9.1: a clear word about locked streams

Some sites scramble the parts of a stream and hand the key only to their own player, without saying so in the list. Video-Catcher loaded all parts of such a video and then failed with "Invalid data found when processing input". **Only the window changed; the extension stays as it is.**

- **New:** before the download starts, Video-Catcher looks at the beginning of the first part. If it is not video, the window says at once "The parts of this video are locked" and nothing is loaded for nothing.
- **Changed:** if this only shows when the file is put together, the message says the same instead of a line from FFmpeg.

Such a video cannot be downloaded: Video-Catcher does not get around DRM and does not take a key out of a player.

Files: `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe`) and the extension (`VideoCatcher-extension-chromium.zip`, `VideoCatcher-extension-firefox.zip` or `.xpi`).

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
